title: JJKCraft
description: Minecraft plugin inspired by Jujutsu Kaisen
body:
# ⚔️ Combat Abilities

### Cursed Energy Strike
- **Damage:** 1.5x  
- **Trigger:** Every 3rd hit, 50% chance, or `/next cursed`

### Divergent Fist
- **Damage:** 2x (delayed 0.3s)  
- **Trigger:** Every 5th hit within 1s, 50% chance, or `/next divergent`

### Black Flash
- **Damage:** 4x + particles + smoke + lightning  
- **Buff (10s):** 
  - Each hit = Cursed Energy Strike  
  - Every 2 hits = Guaranteed Divergent Fist  
- **Trigger:** After Divergent Fist within 2s, 50% chance, or `/next blackflash`

### RCT (Reverse Cursed Technique)
- **Effect:** Heal 5 hearts  
- **Trigger:** Below 2 hearts, 10% chance, or `/next rct`

---

# ⚡ Incomplete Domain / Domain Expansion
- **Trigger:** Automatically below 3 hearts (5%) or `/next domainexpansion`  
- **Effect (5s):** 
  - Player invincible  
  - Nearby players (30-block radius) see title: `Well, I guess it's come to this!`  
  - Chat: `It's ugly, But it will work`  
  - Nearby entities: blinded, slowed, poisoned  

---

# 🧠 Command System

`/next <ability>` forces next occurrence:

| Command | Effect | Trigger |
|---------|--------|--------|
| `/next blackflash` | Black Flash | Next hit |
| `/next divergent` | Divergent Fist | Next hit |
| `/next cursed` | Cursed Energy Strike | Next hit |
| `/next rct` | Reverse Cursed Technique | Next damage |
| `/next domainexpansion` | Incomplete Domain | Instant |

**OP only**

---

# ⚠️ Performance Warning
- Spawns **particles, lightning, effects**  
- May reduce FPS on weaker machines  
- Avoid spamming Domain Expansion
